item.title: Elena Rose on Karol G’s ‘Genuine’ Invitation to Open Her Viajando Por El Mundo Tropitour: ‘I Feel Like I’m Going on Tour With a Friend’
item.description:
[Intro music plays]
Host: "Welcome to our podcast, where we bring you the latest updates on the music scene. Today, we're talking about the exciting news that's trending on Billboard. Venezuelan artist Elena Rose is joining forces with Colombian superstar Karol G on her upcoming tour, Viajando Por El Mundo Tropitour. Let's dive in!"
[Short music transition]
Host: "Elena Rose is currently on her European Alma tour, but she'll be heading back to the States next week to join Karol G as the opening act on select U.S. dates. The two artists have a long-standing friendship and have collaborated in the past. In fact, Rose has written hits like 'MAMIII' for Karol G and Becky G."
[Short clip of "MAMIII" plays]
Host: "Rose will be joining Karol G on 10 U.S. stadium dates, kicking off in Chicago on July 24th and 25th. She's expressed her excitement about the tour, saying it was a 'super organic' decision to join forces with her friend. The two will be performing together on some of the biggest stages in the country."
[Short music transition]
Host: "Elena Rose has had an impressive career so far, releasing her debut EP 'En las Nubes — Con Mis Panas' in 2024, which included the hit single 'Orión'. She's since released two more EPs, 'Bendito Verano' and 'No Quiero Que Se Acabe Este Bendito Verano', which made Billboard's 26 Best Latin Albums of 2026 So Far list."
[Short clip of "Orión" plays]
Host: "Rose is set to join Karol G on the first night of the tour kickoff next Saturday. She's looking forward to the experience, saying it's a chance to learn and grow as an artist. With her unique sound and energetic performances, Elena Rose is sure to bring the heat to the stage alongside Karol G."
[Outro music plays]
Host: "Thanks for tuning in to our podcast. Don't forget to follow us for more updates on the music scene, and catch Elena Rose and Karol G on tour this summer!"
